reproduced_defects.old_behaviour: A one-character exact quotation and a fabricated explanation could pass quote validation and become a validated connection.
reproduced_defects.new_behaviour: Versioned validator rejects quotes shorter than 16 characters, quotes without two meaningful non-goal terms, quotes without shared meaningful terms, identical evidence spans, and overconfident/assertive insufficient_evidence output.

reproduced_defects.old_behaviour: The relationship USD ledger excluded rows with status interrupted even though their reserved tokens had been charged by the Governor.
reproduced_defects.new_behaviour: Interrupted and ambiguous-settlement attempts are included in conservative worst-case liability; validated usage is priced from actual usage; restart does not reset liability.

reproduced_defects.old_behaviour: A consent authorised while Meta was enabled could dispatch after the runtime disabled Meta.
reproduced_defects.new_behaviour: Immediately before dispatch the service re-evaluates provider enablement, provider identity and pinned model against the authorised consent, and rechecks the Governor reservation and USD cap.

reproduced_defects.old_behaviour: Connection reuse matched only current snapshot, historical memory and analysis version, so a local-stub result could satisfy a Meta request.
reproduced_defects.new_behaviour: Reuse requires current snapshot, historical memory, both source fingerprints, exact payload SHA-256, provider identity, pinned model and validator version. Cache hits are marked cached and do not consume a provider dispatch.

reproduced_defects.old_behaviour: ALIVE-14 recorded the CRLF working-tree protocol hash while the Git blob is LF.
reproduced_defects.new_behaviour: Original archive preserved; supplementary reconciliation records both hashes and bytes; future R1 archive hashes use LF bytes; CI verifies reconciliation.
